findings.summary: The guide did not pin an expected executable candidate tree or derive diff evidence from that tree.
The Evaluation recorder did not recompute exact guide/source/tree authority or prove Git object types.
The Evaluation recorder did not require exactly MA-111-01 through MA-111-08 or a complete verdict/approval matrix.
Evaluation evidence validation did not reject a broad enough set of secret-bearing fields and values.
The dist contract did not scan every generated artifact file.
Disabled-call coverage omitted Sidebar, ChatWindow, and UserProfileModal controls.
The reviewer lacked an immutable local export of the complete Issue #111 specification.

report: The exact v4 hash was verified. Lifecycle state, cached no-pull scanning, clean index materialization, Docker environment exclusion, expected-failure Vite build, fixtures, routes, and authorization boundaries were consistent. Seven Major findings still allowed candidate/evidence mismatch or incomplete acceptance coverage. v4 was not approved or executed.
